# csv and delimited

<!-- BEGIN generated by .github/scripts/plugin_pages.py from the package's describe.json -->

Comma-separated and other delimited text: the `csv` format and `delimited` format, from the `csv` package. Declare the package once in `dependencies.yml`; DRE installs it on demand:

```yaml
# dependencies.yml
plugins:
  - csv
```

### `csv` format: options

Set in a report's `output:` (or `format_options.csv` in `dre_project.yml`).

| Option | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `delimiter` | char | `,` | Separates fields. |
| `quote` | char | `"` | Wraps quoted fields; doubled inside them. |
| `quoting` | string | `minimal` | Which fields are quoted: only where needed, all, text columns, or none. One of `minimal`, `all`, `strings`, `none`. |
| `header` | boolean | `true` | Write the column names first. |
| `line_ending` | string | `"\r\n"` | Ends each line. One of `"\n"`, `"\r\n"`. |
| `encoding` | string | `utf-8` | Text encoding, e.g. utf-8, latin1, windows-1252. |
| `null` | string | `""` | Written for a null value. |
| `byte_order_mark` | boolean | `false` | Start a UTF-8 file with a byte order mark. |

### `delimited` format: options

Set in a report's `output:` (or `format_options.delimited` in `dre_project.yml`).

| Option | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `delimiter` | char | `,` | Separates fields. |
| `quote` | char | `"` | Wraps quoted fields; doubled inside them. |
| `quoting` | string | `minimal` | Which fields are quoted: only where needed, all, text columns, or none. One of `minimal`, `all`, `strings`, `none`. |
| `header` | boolean | `true` | Write the column names first. |
| `line_ending` | string | `"\r\n"` | Ends each line. One of `"\n"`, `"\r\n"`. |
| `encoding` | string | `utf-8` | Text encoding, e.g. utf-8, latin1, windows-1252. |
| `null` | string | `""` | Written for a null value. |
| `byte_order_mark` | boolean | `false` | Start a UTF-8 file with a byte order mark. |

<!-- END generated -->

## Writing

- `quoting` (csv, delimited) picks which fields are wrapped in `quote`:
  - `minimal` (the default): only fields holding the delimiter, the quote or a line break;
  - `all`: every field but nulls;
  - `strings`: every value of a text, date, time or timestamp column, and the header; numbers,
    booleans and nulls stay bare unless they hold the delimiter;
  - `none`: no field. A value that can't be written without quotes fails the run, naming the row
    and column.

  A doubled quote escapes a quote inside a quoted field. For tab- or pipe-separated text, use
  `delimited` with `delimiter: "\t"` and, say, `extension: tsv`.
- `null: "NULL"` (csv, delimited) writes that marker for nulls instead of an empty field. It can be
  written unquoted as above: DRE reads a YAML `null:` key as the option `null`.

## Export for a downstream importer

Use CSV for a standard table export, or `delimited` for a receiver requiring tabs, pipes or a
different extension. Starting with the [tutorial project](../examples/tutorial/), replace its
report output with:

```yaml
output:
  format: delimited
  extension: tsv
  delimiter: "\t"
  header: true
  quoting: minimal
  quote: '"'
  null: "NULL"
  encoding: utf-8
  line_ending: "\n"
  byte_order_mark: false
```

Declare `csv` in dependencies for either format. `dre run <report> --preview 5` writes a sample
without delivery. Check the importer with a null, an embedded delimiter and a quoted value,
not only plain numbers. Use `byte_order_mark: true` when a receiver needs a UTF-8 BOM; use
`encoding: windows-1252` only when every required character fits that encoding.

With `quoting: none`, the actual error is
`row <row>, column <col>: the value contains the delimiter, quote or a line break, which quoting: none can't represent`
(the message quotes the column and option with backticks). Restore `minimal` rather than
removing characters silently. An unsupported option yields `invalid-output-option`; move a
destination option out of the output map if it belongs to delivery.
See [output keys](reference-report.md#output), [error codes](reference-error-codes.md),
and [format](glossary.md#format) and [output](glossary.md#output).
